text: The normal CT scan rules out bronchiectasis, but your chronic productive cough with morning exacerbations and recurrent "bronchitis" in a non-smoker is highly suggestive of Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia or a similar mucociliary clearance disorder. I will request specific testing to evaluate ciliary function and look for immunodeficiencies. REQUEST TEST: Sweat_Chloride_Test

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal sweat chloride test rules out Cystic Fibrosis. Given the chronic productive cough, recurrent infections, and normal CT, I need to evaluate for immunodeficiency or other ciliary dyskinesias. REQUEST TEST: Immunoglobulin Levels

speaker: Doctor
text: Normal immunoglobulins rule out common antibody deficiencies, leaving Primary Ciliary Dyskinesia as the leading suspect given the chronic productive cough and recurrent infections. I will request a specific test to evaluate ciliary function directly. REQUEST TEST: Nasal_Nitric_Oxide

speaker: Doctor
